cards.hint: "yah" — "yeah, AND another thing!" (careful: German ja = yes)
"sek-ah" ≈ "sack-a" — a sack as well as a bag
"tie" — a tie OR a bow tie?
"vye" ≈ "vie" — two things vying: this one, or that one?
"Eli" like the name — "Eli, or rather, Elijah"
"moot-tah" ≈ "mutter" — you mutter "but..."
"vahn" ≈ "van" — not a car, but rather a van
"sil-lah" ≈ "silly" — you're silly, because...
"yo-ten" — "yo, that's ten — so let's go!"
"et-tah" — "eh, that..." (it opens a that-clause)
"yohs" — "yes... if"
"kos-kah" ≈ "'cause" — because!
"koon" ≈ "coon" — the raccoon appears when it gets dark
"vye-kah" ≈ "bike-a" — although it's raining, I'll ride my bike
"yot-tah" ≈ "gotta" — you gotta hurry so that you're not late
kun (when) + -nes — wait "when-ness" arrives... until
"kwin" ≈ "queen" — more graceful than a queen
"koo-ten" ≈ "cute" — cute animals, such as kittens
"mick-ah-lee" ≈ "Mickey" — in case Mickey shows up
kun (when) + han — fine, as long as Han brings snacks
